newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Stocks calm before weekend.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Stocks calm before weekend.

text.p: Stocks were quiet during after-hours trading despite a surge in activity during the normal session eariler in the day, traders said Friday.
"There's not much going on," said one trader.
The New York Stock Exchange said the volume for session one was 1,015,500 shares compared with Thursday's 668,800.
There was no session two. On Thursday, the session had a volume of 241,400 shares.
